name: KeePassXC Open-Source Password Manager
free_limit: Free GPL-2.0/GPL-3.0 cross-platform offline password manager for Windows, macOS and Linux, using encrypted KeePass-compatible local vault files, password generation and browser integration; no vendor account or password-count quota.
watch_out: Stores the vault locally; you must handle backups, device synchronization, recovery and security updates. No hosted password-sync service is included. GPL redistribution obligations apply to modified/distributed builds; hardware keys and optional cloud sync providers can cost extra.
